name: Tilia Impact Ventures
aliases: Tilia Impact Ventures, osoba rizikového kapitálu, s.r.o.
decision_note: Prague impact VC (Fund II: EUR 26m first close in Sept 2023 towards a EUR 32m target, EIF/Česká spořitelna-backed) that joined FaceUp's Series A (May 2026), led Minimist's EUR 1m pre-seed (Mar 2026) and Flox Intelligence's USD 3m round (Feb 2026), and backed Delta Green (Oct 2025).

evidence.quote: Tilia Impact Ventures backs Czech and CEE region founders to make systemic environmental and social change, on a global scale.
Prague-based investment firm Tilia Impact Ventures has announced the launch of its €32 million second fund financed by the European Investment Fund and Ceska Sporitelna Bank.
The fund will invest in seed-stage companies with mission-driven entrepreneurs from CEE dealing with climate, education, and healthcare solutions, having a sustainability-focused impact.
Celková investice dosáhla tří milionů dolarů (61,5 milionu Kč) a kromě českého fondu se jí účastnily také mimo jiné Satgana či Genius NY.

Die Runde wurde von Tilia Impact Ventures (mit Unterstützung von InvestEU) angeführt, unter Beteiligung von Business Angels und Family Offices sowie gefördert durch den Call „Wien Lebensqualität“ der Wirtschaftsagentur Wien.
Tilia Impact Ventures Fund II (“the Fund”), managed by Tilia Impact Ventures II GP S.à r.l. (“Tilia”) is an impact fund
Český impactový fond Tilia Impact Ventures vede investici do švédského startupu Flox Intelligence, který vyvíjí systémy umělé inteligence směřující na zvířata.
investice se společenským (sociálním nebo environmentálním) dopadem
Tilia Impact Ventures is a seed-stage impact venture capital firm based in the Czech Republic, and recently announced the successful first closing of its second fund, totaling €26m.
Do investice se pak zapojili i stávající investoři Jiří Hlavenka, Tilia Impact Ventures a Reflex Capital spolu se skupinou andělských investorů
Pražský energetický startup Delta Green získal dva miliony eur, tedy 50 milionů korun, od investorů z Credo Ventures, Tilia Impact Ventures a Purple Ventures.

analyst_notes: Ticket EUR 0.3-1.2m initial is stated on tilia.vc (2026); AIN 2023 said initial tickets up to EUR 1.5m; CVCA 2020 profile (Fund I era) said CZK 1-5m - the newest own statement is used. Capital = Fund II size announced at launch (EUR 32m, AIN.UA 2023-09-21); other reports (Causeartist/SeeNews) say first closing at EUR 26m; final close size not found. Fund I (2018, CZK 43m per CC.cz / CZK 62.7m per CVCA 2020) not listed separately. Tilia's homepage also shows '37m+ EUR unlocked for impact from investors' (not used as capital, basis unclear). Fund II is managed by Tilia Impact Ventures II GP S.à r.l. (Luxembourg, per SFDR page e8); no LEI or RCS number found, registry_id left null. The Czech ORK s.r.o. (IČO 17848911) and Tilia Impact Partners s.r.o. (IČO 17621615) share Tilia's Drtinova 557/10 address; the exact role split between them is not public - Partners s.r.o. assumed to be the Czech management/adviser entity. Flox Intelligence round: Lupa.cz (2026-02-27) says Tilia leads (e9), total USD 3m (e6); other sources call it Seed+ (EUR 2.5m). Minimist pre-seed EUR 1m led by Tilia (Trending Topics 2026-03-25; amount stated in the same article's preceding sentence). Also in window but not cited (page blocked to scripts): Lifeyear EUR 2.8m round, July 2025 (Digital Health, Invest in Estonia). Sector list: 'sector-agnostic, impact-driven' with climate/education/health named in the 2023 fund launch. Funds now list the first close (26m) and the target (32m, AIN e4). Scope rule: added two Czech in-window deals - FaceUp USD 5m Series A with Tilia as existing investor (CzechCrunch 2026-05-19; round amount from the same article, as cited in reflex-capital) and Delta Green EUR 2m from Credo, Tilia and Purple (CzechCrunch 2025-10-15); latest dated activity is now 2026-05-19.
